suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 applies to JetBrains Kotlin versions before 2.4.20 and describes unsafe deserialization in Kotlin build cache metadata. The desktop app consumes kotlin-stdlib as runtime support for OkHttp; it does not execute Kotlin compiler/build-cache tooling. As of 2026-07-11, Maven Central has 2.4.20-Beta1 but no stable 2.4.20, so this suppression must be revisited when a stable fixed release is published.

CVE-2026-23907 and CVE-2026-33929 affect the PDFBox ExtractEmbeddedFiles example code. Recetas Familiares Desktop only uses PDFBox to create recipe PDFs (PDDocument/PDPage/PDPageContentStream) and does not call or copy ExtractEmbeddedFiles. Apache documents 3.0.8 as the fixed 3.x line for CVE-2026-33929, but as of 2026-07-11 org.apache.pdfbox:pdfbox:3.0.8 is not published to Maven Central. Revisit this suppression when 3.0.8 or a later 3.x release is available.

Same PDFBox example-code issue as above, detected on the transitive pdfbox-io module because Dependency-Check maps it to the Apache PDFBox CPE. The desktop app does not extract embedded files from user PDFs. Revisit when PDFBox 3.0.8 or a later 3.x release is available.
